title: Kheng language - Wikipedia
text: Khengkha is a dialect found in the small Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan. Khengkha is part of the larger branch of Sino-Tibetan language family but falls into the subcategories of: Tibetio-Burman, Western Tubeto-Burman, Bodish, East Bodish, Bumthang, and Khengkha.

text: Khengkha nouns and pronouns are always unmarked in the absolutive case, whereas the ergative case is marked by forms ending with the vowel -i, as Table 2 shows.
